onboarding.disclaimerBody: Frenchie Skin Tracker is an educational tracking tool designed to help French Bulldog owners log and monitor their pet's skin health over time. This app does NOT diagnose medical conditions, does NOT prescribe treatments, and does NOT replace the professional judgment of a licensed veterinarian. All content, tips, recommendations, and AI responses within this app are for general informational and educational purposes only. Always consult a qualified veterinarian for diagnosis, treatment decisions, and any health concern about your pet. If your dog shows any emergency warning signs listed above, seek immediate veterinary care.
onboarding.termsSummary: The simple rules for using the app, what your account can do, and how plans and cancellations work.
onboarding.termsIntro: By using Frenchie Skin Tracker you're agreeing to a few simple rules. It's an app that helps you keep track of your French Bulldog's skin health.
termsPoints: You need to be 18 or older to make an account.
Keep your password safe — your account is yours to look after.
Free version: up to 5 check-ins and 3 chat messages a day (no vet download yet).
Full plan: as many check-ins and chats as you want, plus a download for your vet.
Your plan renews on its own, but you can stop paying anytime from your preferences.
Yearly plans: money back within 30 days (we split it fairly). Monthly plans don't have partial refunds.
If someone breaks these rules, we may pause their account.
The app comes 'as is' — we work hard on it, but we can't promise it's perfect for everything.
onboarding.termsFooter: Want every detail? You can read the full Terms anytime on the Terms page.
onboarding.privacySummary: What we keep, why we keep it, and how we look after it. Short version: your stuff stays yours.
onboarding.privacyIntro: Here's what we save and why, in plain words:
privacyPoints: Your account: your email, your name if you add it, and your language.
Your Frenchie's profile: name, age, weight, and any photos — kept safe in our storage.
Skin check-ins: the dates, scores, photos, notes, and food you log.
Payments: handled fully by Stripe. We never see or save your card number.
Chat history: saved so the assistant remembers your conversation — never used to train AI.
Consent records: we note when you accept these documents (just the date and version).
onboarding.privacyFooter: You can ask us to delete everything whenever you like. The full Privacy Policy is on the Privacy page.
onboarding.consentFooter: We save each 'yes' on its own with the date, just so you have a record.
